scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The motivating OU-reset source first appeared on 2023-01-28; Eule--Metzger (2015) supplies earlier general renewal theory and is cited as supporting prior work, not an origin of this specific spectral classification. The theorem is for integer Erlang stages, initially reset harmonic diffusion, strictly positive rates and diffusivity. Infinite sign changes can become exponentially small and do not imply universal finite-time monotonicity failures. No independent priority or mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Sharp Erlang-shape threshold for oscillatory variance relaxation in a reset harmonic diffusion
